evidence: Current title: Screen Ruler showing behind applications, visible only from desktop

Current report excerpt: ### Microsoft PowerToys version

0.75.1

### Installation method

PowerToys auto-update

### Running as admin

Yes

### Area(s) with issue?

Screen ruler, System tray interaction

### Steps to reproduce

1. Click the powertoys icon in system tray
2. Select the screen ruler icon from the shortcuts menu which is now open.
3. Screen ruler will now only display behind applications. Using shortcut key (Win+Shift+M) shows screen ruler in front of applications.

### ✔️ Expected Behavior

The on screen ruler bar (defaulted to top of screen) is visible in front of all applications.

### ❌ Actual Behavior

Screen ruler bar only displays behind applications. Using shortcut key (Win+Shift+M) shows screen ruler in front of applications.

### Other Software

_No response_
